cases.title: SYS-50 Health 失败：停止新版本、恢复 Binary/Config/Unit、Health 后记录 ROLLBACK_SUCCESS。
cases.expected: SYS-50 Health 失败：停止新版本、恢复 Binary/Config/Unit、Health 后记录 ROLLBACK_SUCCESS。；适用用户操作、Hub/Agent实际效果与UI反馈一致，失败/反向路径无额外副作用。
cases.actual: journal 时序 VERIFYING(v3 SHA, unit inactive) → ROLLING_BACK(v2 SHA/config v2/unit v2/active) → DONE；Execution FAILED health check failed；node state unhealthy/3.0/error；无伪 healthy；v3 binary 无残留。

covered_dimensions.description: journal 时序 VERIFYING(v3 SHA, unit inactive) → ROLLING_BACK(v2 SHA/config v2/unit v2/active) → DONE；Execution FAILED health check failed；node state unhealthy/3.0/error；无伪 healthy；v3 binary 无残留。

remaining_dimensions: The product records a successful rollback as ROLLING_BACK -> DONE in the deployment journal (PRODUCT.md §42 lists PREPARING/STOPPED/REPLACED/STARTED/VERIFYING/DONE/ROLLING_BACK). There is no distinct "ROLLBACK_SUCCESS" journal phase to assert; the success verdict is carried by the Execution result (FAILED + block_reason) plus the restored-and-healthy v2 state, and the Agent's deploy result sets rollback=true (visible only in the Hub process log, not exposed through the API).
ROLLING_BACK lasted ~1s and was captured by ~0.5s journal sampling; the ordering proof does not depend on catching it (the binary SHA flips from v3 to v2 between the VERIFYING and final samples).

The health failure is induced by an owned artifact whose binary exits immediately, so the unit never becomes active; TCP/HTTP/COMMAND health-check failure modes were not each exercised in this batch (only the systemd type).

cases.title: SYS-52 Backup 缺失、权限不足、磁盘不足的明确失败。
cases.expected: SYS-52 Backup 缺失、权限不足、磁盘不足的明确失败。；适用用户操作、Hub/Agent实际效果与UI反馈一致，失败/反向路径无额外副作用。
cases.actual: 三种真实内核错误均明确失败且无半替换：备份目录不可创建 mkdir file exists；权限不足(chattr +i) operation not permitted；磁盘不足(128KiB tmpfs + 1MiB 备份) no space left on device。正向对照：目录真正缺失时产品自动创建并 SUCCESS。

covered_dimensions.description: 三种真实内核错误均明确失败且无半替换：备份目录不可创建 mkdir file exists；权限不足(chattr +i) operation not permitted；磁盘不足(128KiB tmpfs + 1MiB 备份) no space left on device。正向对照：目录真正缺失时产品自动创建并 SUCCESS。

remaining_dimensions: The three seams are harness-side (owned path only, released immediately after each scenario): chattr +i immutable directory for the permission-denied mode (the Agent runs as root, so mode-based denial is not applicable) and a 128 KiB tmpfs mount for the disk-full mode; both produce real kernel errors (EPERM / ENOSPC) inside the untouched product backup code path.

"Backup 缺失" is covered as "backup destination present but unusable/not creatable"; a directory that is genuinely absent is created by the product (positive control above). The product's separate "source file absent" semantics (backup sentinel "absent:") was not the target of this case.

The deployment journal records PREPARING -> DONE even for a prepare-stage failure (a verify-absent sentinel); the failure verdict is carried by the Execution (FAILED) and the Application node state (unhealthy + error). Recorded as an observation, not a case failure.
When the backup write fails mid-way a partial backup file remains in the backup directory (observed in the tmpfs scenario and removed with the tmpfs); no application host file was modified.

remaining_dimensions: 产品实现形式是“拒绝创建 Execution（HTTP 400）”，而不是创建一条 BLOCKED 状态的 Execution；语义上等同 PRODUCT.md/AGENTS 要求的“Hub 下发前校验、BLOCKED、不能等执行后才失败”。已作为实现形态观察记录，不计为用例失败。

cases.title: 节点批量 Native Agent 自升级：混选 Docker、暂停/离线、重复在途升级、部分失败、取消确认、版本更新和重连。
cases.expected: 节点批量 Native Agent 自升级：混选 Docker、暂停/离线、重复在途升级、部分失败、取消确认、版本更新和重连。；适用用户操作、Hub/Agent实际效果与UI反馈一致，失败/反向路径无额外副作用。

remaining_dimensions: Deployment-journal from_version is written from the synced Application definition at deploy time, not from the previously installed version: the v1->v2 upgrade row shows from_version=to_version=2.0. The previously installed version is instead proven by the pre-deploy binary SHA (A1) and by the backup content SHA == A1. Recorded as a product observation, not a case failure.
An explicit re-deploy rewrites the binary byte-identically (mtime changes); idempotency was therefore measured as "identical content SHA, single unit, no extra journal/Execution", not as "no write".

No browser UI was driven for this batch; caller-side feedback is the Hub API (POST /api/applications/{id}/deploy response, GET /api/executions/{id}, GET /api/applications/{id}/state). The Applications/Executions UI for this feature is already covered by the reused SYS-44 evidence (managed-app-ui.json).

The PREPARING-phase crash recovery mentioned in the batch plan (P0-002 attempt03) was not re-executed for AR-27; crash recovery is instead exercised end-to-end in AR-29 (rollback after a crash in VERIFYING). The previously recorded PREPARING evidence remains available for Root review.

remaining_dimensions: The crash is a harness SIGKILL of the owned child Agent process (a real process death, no product source change); Product-internal panics are not simulated.
